monthly_review.summary: You've reduced volume but increased intensity this month, shifting toward more Zone 3–4 work and slightly faster average pace — a sign of focused, quality-oriented training despite fewer runs.
monthly_review.highlight: Your aerobic efficiency improved (+0.18 m/sec per bpm) despite higher average HR and reduced volume — indicating better cardiovascular economy at given intensities.

goal_tracker.message: You need 25.5 more km across 6 sessions in the remaining 18 days to match last month’s volume — averaging ~4.3 km per session.

insights.title: Improved efficiency despite higher HR
insights.body: Aerobic efficiency rose from 13.46 to 13.64 m/sec per bpm while avg HR increased 4 bpm — suggesting your heart is delivering oxygen more effectively per beat, likely due to recent Zone 3–4 emphasis (26% Z3, 23% Z4 this month vs 31% Z3, 15% Z4 last month).

insights.title: Significant shift into higher-intensity zones
insights.body: Zone 4 time jumped from 15% to 23%, and Zone 5 appeared (10% this month vs 1% last month), reflecting intentional intensity — but Z1 dropped sharply (16% vs 24%), risking under-recovery.

insights.title: Cadence-stride trade-off evident in long run
insights.body: On your 14.1 km run (2026-07-12), cadence was 151 spm but stride length dropped to 70.36 cm (lowest in recent runs) and ground contact increased to 319 ms — signs of fatigue-induced form breakdown late in the run.

insights.title: High-intensity density without proportional recovery
insights.body: This month’s 5 runs delivered 3.0 avg aerobic TE — nearly matching last month’s 2.7 across 11 runs — meaning each session is ~25% more metabolically demanding, yet only one easy run (Z1/Z2) appears in recent logs (2026-07-08: HR 129, TE 2.7).

recommendations.action: Do a 6 km Zone 2 run (HR ≤135 bpm) on 2026-07-15 with cadence ≥148 spm and focus on relaxed arm swing to reinforce aerobic base and recovery capacity.
recommendations.reason: Only one recent run (2026-07-08) fell clearly in Z1/Z2; rebuilding low-HR volume is critical to offset high-intensity density and support efficiency gains.

recommendations.action: Perform a 4 km progressive run on 2026-07-18: start at 530 sec/km (8:50/km), increase pace by 5 sec/km every km (ending at 515 sec/km), keeping HR between 145–155 bpm and cadence ≥152 spm.
recommendations.reason: Targets Zone 3–4 specificity (currently 49% of this month’s HR distribution) while reinforcing pace–HR coupling and cadence control observed in your faster efforts (e.g., 2026-07-05: 154 spm @ 511 sec/km).

recommendations.action: Add 2x 30-sec strides post-run on 2026-07-20 (after an easy 5 km), focusing on quick turnover (≥160 spm) and minimal vertical oscillation (<7.5 cm).
recommendations.reason: Your recent vertical oscillation averages 7.7–8.5 cm; lowering it improves efficiency, and strides at high cadence reinforce neuromuscular coordination without adding load.

weekly_focus.description: Balance the recent intensity surge with dedicated low-HR aerobic work and form-focused neuromuscular drills to protect efficiency gains and prevent fatigue-driven breakdown.
suggested_sessions: Zone 2 endurance run (6 km, HR ≤135 bpm)
Progressive tempo run (4 km, pace 530→515 sec/km)
